Build's clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount` — so it crashed reading `.toFixed` off `undefined`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false` — so it threw on every unset flag.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats `undefined` as `false`. The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, nothing broken.
